settings.name_in_paper: Budgeted online influence maximization, IC model with edge-level semi-bandit feedback (unknown costs)
unmapped: Independent cascade diffusion on a known directed graph G=(V,E); edge weights Bernoulli(w*_ij) unknown
Probabilistically triggered arms: only edges out of influenced nodes are observed
Random costs in [0,1] per node plus fixed cost C_0 per round (c*_0>0), observed with semi-bandit feedback; costs may be correlated with diffusion
Total budget B over all rounds; random stopping round tau_B; seed sets of any size
Regret is (1-1/e-eps)-approximation regret against the optimal policy F*_B
Reward is the spread (number of influenced nodes)
settings.definition_quote: R_{B,\varepsilon}(\pi) \triangleq (1-1/e-\varepsilon)F^\star_{B} - F_{B}(\pi), where F^\star_{B} is the best possible value of F_{B} over all policies ... We assume that the feedback received by the agent at round t is {W_{ij,t}, ij in E, S_t ->W_t i}. The agent also receives semi-bandit feedback from the costs.

source.label: thm:CUCBregret
source.quote: If $\pi$ is the policy described in Algorithm~\ref{algo:CUCB}, then R_{B,\varepsilon}(\pi) = O(log B (sum_{i in V} |V| (lambda* + d_i p_{i,max} |V|)/Delta_{i,min})).

results.notes: Quantity is (1-1/e-eps)-approximation regret vs the optimal budgeted policy, recorded as 'other'. B is the total budget. Appendix also mentions a problem-independent bound O(|V| sqrt(B log B sum_i d_i p_{i,max})) informally. Non-budgeted version said to reduce to Wang & Chen (2017) analysis with improved factor.

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: If $\pi$ is the policy following \textsc{boim-cucb}$_5$, then R_{B,\varepsilon}(\pi) = O(log B (sum_{i in V} |V| (lambda* + |V||E| log^2|V|)/Delta_{i,min} + lambda* |V|^2)).

results.notes: Text also states an informal non-budgeted analogue O(log T sum_i |V|^2|E|log^2|V|/Delta_{i,min}) for cardinality-constrained OIM.

source.label: thm:low
source.quote: If $\pi$ is the policy \textsc{boim-cucb}$_1$, and if all seeds selected have a cardinality bounded by $m,$ then we have R_{B,eps}(pi)=O(log B (sum_{i in V} m (lambda* + m|V|^2 d_i log^2(|E|))/Delta_{i,min} + lambda* |V|^2 |E|)).

results.notes: Non-budgeted analogue stated informally: O(log T (sum_i m^2|V|^2 d_i log^2|E|/Delta_{i,min} + |E||V|^2)).
